card.name: Start of surnames and proper names
card.fires_on: The first piece of a rare proper name, usually a surname, split into parts, such as Kod in Kodak, Sc in Scriver or Che in Chea. Often follows a first name or an opening parenthesis in a citation.

modes.label: Surname in running text
modes.description: The opening piece of a person's surname after a first name or title.
modes.example: Secretary Ron<< Fr>>anks for the commemoration

modes.label: Citation author
modes.description: The opening piece of an author's surname inside a parenthetical citation.

card.writes: It pushes toward continuations beginning with "ech" or "echo" and away from "cho", which gives no clear link to the name contexts.
card.plain: It fires on the first fragment of an unusual surname that the model has to spell out in pieces.
